audit: answers, 5th: 하루 두 번 식후에 드세요. (식후에 하루 두 번 드세요.) → 하루 두 번 식후에 드세요. (식후에 하루 두 번 드세요. / 하루 두 번 식후에 드시면 돼요.)

review: Dialogue, pharmacist's 2nd line and Exercise 3 '언제부터 그랬어요?': the pharmacist uses the honorific -시- for the customer everywhere else ('불편하세요', '드시는 거', '식사하시고 드세요'), but this line drops it and becomes less polite to the customer. Change it to '언제부터 그러셨어요?' in both places.

Exercises 1, 4 and 5 all use the same '하루 두 번' (twice a day), and the answers to 4 and 5 are almost the same frame ('하루 두 번 …' + a dosing verb). This gives little practice with counting tablets (한 번에 ~ 알씩) or with checking 식후, so the worksheet gets thin. Change Exercise 5 to 'You think the pharmacist said two tablets at a time. Ask a question to check, ending in 먹으면 돼요?' (answer: '한 번에 두 알씩 먹으면 돼요?'). Or change Exercise 4 to a different frequency and timing, such as 하루 한 번 and 자기 전에.

fixes.problem: 'Me duele un poco el estómago' means 'my stomach hurts'. The English says 'feels a bit upset'. This is the example for 불편하다 ('to feel unwell'), so it shouldn't describe pain, which is 아프다.
fixes.fix: Tengo el estómago un poco revuelto.

fixes.problem: The English sentence the learner has to put into Korean was itself translated ('하루에 두 번, 식후에 드세요.'). This gives away the answer, so the exercise no longer asks what the English asks. The sentence to translate must stay in English.
fixes.fix: 다음 지시를 약사가 말하는 방식으로 한국어로 쓰세요: 'Take it twice a day, after meals.'

fixes.problem: 「上級」は「advanced」という意味の独立したレベル名で、「初級(上級)」は自己矛盾しています。原文の「(high)」は初級の中の上の段階を指します。
'高级' means 'advanced' (a separate proficiency level), so '初级(高级)' reads as 'Beginner (Advanced)', which contradicts itself. The English means the upper part of the beginner level.
The Korean quote is altered: the space after the comma in '하루 두 번, 한 번에' was removed ('하루 두 번,한 번에'). The Korean must stay exactly as in the English line.
fixes.fix: 药剂师说:'하루 두 번, 한 번에 한 알씩 드세요.' 一天要吃几片药?请用中文或韩文回答。

fixes.problem: 'A neighborhood pharmacy in Korea' is rendered as 'a pharmacy in a Korean district', which suggests a Korean quarter (like a Koreatown) instead of an ordinary local pharmacy in Korea.
fixes.fix: Eine Apotheke (약국) in der Nachbarschaft in Korea, an einem Wochentag. Ein Kunde mit einer Erkältung kommt herein, um ohne Rezept Medizin zu kaufen.

fixes.problem: 'Mir ist der Magen etwas flau' is unnatural German; the idiomatic phrase is 'Mir ist etwas flau im Magen'.
fixes.fix: Mir ist etwas flau im Magen.
